name: snapshot_default
description: Parsed by aecli helper from files: snapshot_default.txt

filters.name: SET4
filters.regex_pattern: Detector 6253|CellSetupFailed|ERR\/RROM.*(timer expired|Received timeout)|LNBTS.*CELL_M-.*OnAirDone to|Detector 1868 Radio.*CELL.* active|Detector 4261.*CELL.* active|CellDriver.*proceduralState.*changed.*OnAirDone to|CellDriver.*operationalState.*changed.*Enabled to Disabled

filters.name: SET5
filters.regex_pattern: GPIO reset executed|\*\* FATAL |DSP cores crashed|Core declared dead|ERR: DSP crash info|Killed process|core dumped|dumped core|Supervision detected|\.core\.xz completed |crash.andler|.ssertion |EAaErrorFatality\_System|EAaErrorFatality\_Supervision|EAaErrorFatality\_Fatal|DspCrash|MAC Assert|L2 ASSERT|MACPS Assert|handleCoreDumpCompleted|Kernel panic|Fatal exception|FATAL ERROR|Core was generated by|Segmentation fault|coreDumping.*crashinfo|lfs\-coredump.sh in|unhandled exception|halt_dsp|DSP HALTED|ERR.*CriticalSwComponentFailureAl|PANIC in|EM Dispatcher Hang condition detected
filters.ignore_regex_pattern: crashHandler\.sh|embedded assertion|Unable to parse input tree|stratix.*sd_bus_message_unref.*Aborting|(folder|move|root.*root|crash_logs).*crashhandler|assertion.*fails.*TIDX|Path already being watched|rsync.*L1_RANNIC.*crashhandler|boot script after ReadyToLock

filters.name: SET6
filters.description: Unexpected BTS/BBMOD or Virtual Node reset
filters.regex_pattern: causing reboot|causes reboot|calling ddal_watchdog_reboot\(\)|BTS reset requested|MaxResetLoopCounter|(ERR|WRN).*HWA/SUPERVISOR.*(VirtualNode.*state changed to FAILED|failure in virtual node)|(ERR|WRN).*Virtual node.*failed unexpectedly|Forced reboot.*graceful shutdown|err.*Watchdog timeout|Executing recovery.*eset

filters.name: SET7
filters.regex_pattern: ERR.*(CCS|LFS).*(Kernel|CCSRT |AaRTOS|AaError|AaPro|CCSDaemon)| ERR.*\(pid\:|CCSRT.*ERR\:|Exception stack|dump_stack|calltrace|call trace|Call Trace|Tainted|ERR.*Preparing Error Exception Report|kernel NULL pointer|ERR/.*code exception|kernel.*Internal error|asp.*err.*Failed to.*service
filters.ignore_regex_pattern: AaSysComGwAddRouteExt.*route.*(is already present|Registration failed with status)|failed to register to AaTrbl|level \(ERR\)|AaConfigRadParseLine.*Error when parsing line|Please report to.*kernel|PrintDumpReceiv ERR/CCS/AaSysLog.*INF/

filters.name: SET8
filters.regex_pattern: CRNTI mismatch|status Nok from Datamanager|ERR\/.*crnti.*not match|hanging bearer|ERR\/.*not found or.*already in use|WRN.*(UE.*not.*(found|in database)|No such.*in UE DB|UE.*already in database)|(ERR/|WRN/).*nknown RNTI|(WRN|warning).*Cannot.*(find ue|remove UE from any cell)|ERR.*(unknownOrAlreadyAllocatedGnbCuUeF1apid)|ECause5G_ObjectAlreadyExists
filters.ignore_regex_pattern: measurement report dropped|Band index for own band|Cat\-M UE not found in Harq buffer|Cell Traffic Trace procedures cannot be performed|ERR/macps.*AlgorithmData.*CDlPsAlgorithmData.*setInitialTaValues crnti.*not found|ERR/.*Active procedure.*not matching with received one|CellTraceParam found|ignoring own cell.*previously removed

filters.name: SET9
filters.regex_pattern: Out of memory |invoked oom-killer|No space left|Memory allocation.*failed|Not enough memory|ERR/.*File Quota exceeded.*removing files failed|kernel.*oom-kill

filters.name: SET10
filters.regex_pattern: l1_application.*(unhandled exception|EM ERROR|FATAL|doFatalCrash)|fault in l1_application|L1SW.*(Cannot find srs req|leka_rx stuck detected|is_decoder_pusb_stuck|is_pucch_f2f3_stuck|State_Crashing|Fatal Error|Isolate.*crashed)|(asp|asc..(b|c)|fsp)\-.*systemd.*(Start operation timed out)|ERR.*(leka_tx|LEKA TX).*stuck|(asp|asc..(b|c)|fsp).*Sending alarm.*2087|(asp|asc)\-.*exception handler|(Processing fault|Sending alarm).*2087.*L1|ERR/ctrlTestability.*logIdCrashHandling|handleM.abFatalError|M.AB (C|c)rash|l1.*\[FATAL\]
filters.ignore_regex_pattern: CrashTestFlag|MHAB crash initiator is not found

filters.name: SET11
filters.ignore_regex_pattern: configuration is already present|HW trace initialized|received SYSCOM_EM_EVENT_ID_REGISTER_ACK|Received AutohealingSubscribeReq

filters.name: SET13
filters.regex_pattern: HSDPA Setup rejected|Recv Nack from|CACRejection|Handover failed|T300 expired|MaxRlcRetransExceed|MaxRlcRetransmission exceeded|cause MaxRlcRetr|WRN.*(UeContextSetupFailure|UeContextModificationFailure|Rnti not allocated|SendSgnbAdditionRequestReject|UE.*failed due to lack of resources|UE.*allocation of.*resources failed|Cannot add to admitted users|CauseRadioNetwork.*resource allocation.*failed|Not enough.*for.*UE|Pucch.*exceeded the size.*array)|ERR.*(No ID available in range|no free Id remaining|UE.*get data failed|TEID allocation failed|No PucchResourceSet0 found for rnti)|RrcSetupComplete timeout.*not received

filters.name: SET15
filters.ignore_regex_pattern: tWaitingRlRecoverSA has been started|tWaitingRlRecoverSA already running

filters.name: SET16
filters.regex_pattern: RAP msg3.*failed|RachReceiver.*Timer expired for preamble|handleRaFailure.*raState.*dl_awaitMsg3|WRN/.*RACH fail due
